description: This PHP source file defines a console command class 'ResetDatabaseCommand' within the 'OrangeHRM' project, specifically for functional testing. The class provides functionality to reset the database to its initial state during testing by invoking a service method.

classes.name: ResetDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A console command to reset the database to its initial state for testing purposes.

methods.description: Returns the name of the command 'instance:reset-db'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to restore the database to its initial savepoint and outputs a success message.
